mods.name: Point-to-Point Portals
mods.description: Immersive, balanced 1-to-1 fast-travel portals powered by Redstone.

releases.notes:
### Added
- Client-side oval above linked, powered Teleporters using the live animated vanilla Nether portal sprite and its native opacity, framed by a violet/cyan border and vanilla portal particles. The vertical plane faces the viewer, renders within 32 blocks and disappears when power or the link is lost.
- Opt-in graphical regression (`runPortalClientTest`) in an isolated client world, with screenshots and checks for animation and activation/deactivation.

### Changed
- Linked, unpowered pads retain the pre-oval active appearance, level-12 light, portal particles and ambient sound. The oval and transport still require Redstone.
- Updated gameplay documentation and included real-client active/standby screenshots. Recipes, exclusive pairing, cross-dimension transport and cooldowns remain unchanged.

### Validation
- The server regression suite contains 38 tests. The separate real-client test checks the Nether-textured surface, cyan border, animation, level-12 light in linked states and oval disappearance without power or a link. Additional camera-angle, occlusion and many-portal performance checks remain manual.

releases.notes:
### Added
- Complete Italian (`it_it`), Spanish (`es_es`), French (`fr_fr`) and German (`de_de`) translations for item names, tooltips and gameplay messages, generated alongside English.
- Original transparent 32×32 Phase Tuner texture with an obsidian grip, copper mount, violet crystal and redstone inset.
- Original copper-and-obsidian Teleporter textures: nine 32×32 faces covering inactive, standby and active states, with matching inventory appearance.
- Three server interaction regression tests covering the Phase Tuner through the normal player interaction dispatcher in Survival/Creative and offhand dispatch.
- Illustrated crafting recipes using actual game/mod textures, artwork previews and scripts to regenerate documentation images.

### Fixed
- Right-clicking a Teleporter with the Phase Tuner now reaches the tool's pairing interaction instead of being consumed by the block's status message.
- Corrected the README's Phase Tuner recipe description: amethyst shard above an Ender Pearl above a Blaze Rod.

### Changed
- Updated gameplay, localization, artwork and regression documentation for 0.1.0. Recipes, exclusive bidirectional links, Redstone requirements and cooldown behavior are unchanged.
- Regression suite now contains 38 tests. Real-client visual/gameplay checks remain separate; intermittent tick-2 cross-dimension arrival assertions observed during development are documented.

releases.notes:
### Added
- Lightweight tag-triggered GitHub release workflow: Java 25 packaging only, version/changelog/branch validation, checked JARs and SHA-256 checksums, draft upload before publication, and RC support. No Actions runs on branch pushes and no tests or benchmarks in the release job.
- Release JAR filenames include the mod version, Minecraft version and Fabric loader type (for example `pointportals-0.0.10-mc26.2-fabric.jar`); tags remain plain `vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH`.
- Isolated, opt-in loading benchmark with fresh worlds, loaded/unloaded/new-target fixtures, serial and burst workloads, completed vanilla tick timings and validated JFR/operation CSV summaries. Checks reciprocal pairing, stale-target recovery, arrival identity/position/rotation, cooldown and target release after ticket expiry.
- First three-repeat stress campaign: 1,440 verified operations, 3,423 completed tick samples and 36 successful target-release checks. Published the summary and attribution limits in `docs/loading-performance-results.md`; ordinary build still passes 35/35 GameTests.
- JFR events for explicit synchronous portal chunk resolution, enabled by an active recording, with operation, dimension, chunk coordinates, initial loaded state and completion status.
- Opt-in Loom recording via `-PportalProfile`, PowerShell percentile/CSV summaries and a loading-performance protocol. Dedicated-server confirmation at normal 20 TPS pacing remains pending.

### Changed
- Bumped the mod version to 0.0.10 and pinned Fabric Loom to 1.19.4.
- Aligned development and gameplay documentation with Java 25, Minecraft 26.2, official Mojang mappings, deferred unloaded-twin reconciliation and the implemented cooldown behavior.

releases.notes:
Point-to-Point Portals 0.0.9 for Minecraft Java 26.2, Java 25, Fabric Loader >= 0.20.1 and Fabric API.

Includes all changes since v0.0.5:

- 0.0.6: portal safety fixes, vanilla temporary arrival tickets, persistence coverage and nine tuner regression scenarios.
- 0.0.7: real chunk unload/reload reconciliation and arrival-ticket expiry coverage.
- 0.0.8: actual tuner interactions across Overworld and Nether, including occupied endpoints and stale selections.
- 0.0.9: entity travel to/from the End and player travel in both directions across Overworld/Nether and Overworld/End.

Validation: full Gradle build passed all 35 GameTests. Test classes are excluded from the distributed mod JAR.

Manual checks remain for a real server restart, client UI/messages/sounds and dimension-change acknowledgement. Player tests use simulated connections; synchronous chunk-loading performance has not been measured.

Install pointportals-0.0.9.jar with Fabric API. The sources JAR is provided separately.
